reader.requirement: At 85 the range of a PERFORM is every statement executed from its start to its implicit return. That includes statements reached by GO TO, CALL, EXIT and nested PERFORM within it, and declaratives (error and debugging) they trigger, and the statements need not be contiguous. Control that leaves the named procedures and later completes the last statement of procedure-name-2 (or procedure-name-1) still returns.

reader.notes: An out-of-line PERFORM is a bounded recursive dispatch over the program's whole pc space. Any statement reached from the range (GO TO, CALL, declarative, nested PERFORM) therefore runs inside it, and the return fires only when the exit paragraph completes. Every channel GR11 names was probed at 85, including the 85-only segmentation and debugging arms.
